segments.final_text:
To put it quite bluntly, 
that would be the case.
segments.speaker: BRIAN

segments.final_text: What the hell?
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: In my past life, I was used, abused,
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: and cast aside like a dirty rag in the end.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Is it going to be the same here?
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Amagi.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Yes?
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: It sounds like I was used and abandoned.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: It does.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
And you're not very welcome 
in this society, either.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Right.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: We're both outcasts, you and I.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Then, Amagi, why don't we outcasts team up?
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: M-Master Liam?
segments.speaker: BRIAN

segments.final_text: I'm gonna drag my way out of this mess.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
Once I do, I'll gain power and 
take everything I'll ever want.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: And I'll show everyone who's boss.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: So, Amagi, team up with me.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: No.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
My purpose from the very beginning 
has been to serve you, Master.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
There is no need to ask me
 to team up with you.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: Also, I believe I am not an outcast,
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: because you said you needed me.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: Amagi...
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
So long as you live, I will 
continue to fulfill my purpose.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: I guess you're right.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
So, please, feel free to 
order me as you please.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: Okay, Amagi.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
I will now confer upon you 
the three laws of robotics.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: These laws exist to protect humanity.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
This should make it easier 
for people to accept you.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Right.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
The first law: A robot may 
not injure a human being...
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Human being?
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Human?
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Nah, screw that. I don't care about others.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: I will live life for myself.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
What happens to everybody 
else is not my concern.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
Let's start over. You don't need 
the three laws of robotics.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
I will confer upon you
 my three laws of maid robots!
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
Awaiting the "three laws 
of maid robots" commands.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
The first law: A maid robot 
may not injure her master or,
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
through inaction, allow her 
master to come to harm.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: First law of maid robots, understood.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
The second law: A maid robot must obey 
the orders given by her master
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
except where such orders would 
conflict with the first law!
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Second law of maid robots, understood.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
The third law: A maid robot must protect her 
own existence as long as such protection
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
does not conflict with 
the first or second law!
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Third law of maid robots, understood.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: "Human beings"? Screw them all!
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: A maid robot need only serve her own master!
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: You are correct, Master.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
Amagi, I want to revitalize 
House Banfield's domain.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Got any ideas?
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
I am an AI. My ideas may not agree 
with the empire's philosophies.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
But I am equipped with functions 
that can assist with governance.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
If you so wish it, I could provide 
you with administrative support.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: But I know nothing about governance.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Can you still help me out?
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
I would recommend utilizing 
an education capsule.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
In six months, they can install
 ten years' worth of knowledge in your brain
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: and even strengthen your body.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: Who will manage the domain during that time?
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: I will, in your stead.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
Okay, that sounds good. 
Let's go with that idea.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
You mustn't! It's too dangerous 
to let an AI run a whole domain!
segments.speaker: BRIAN

segments.final_text: What if it turns against humanity?
segments.speaker: BRIAN

segments.final_text: It'll be fine.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: But...
segments.speaker: BRIAN

segments.final_text:
Because I, her master, do not 
wish for mankind to be wiped out.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: It is as Master says.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
That would go against
 the second law of maid robots.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: I will only attack if Master commands me to.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: So you will attack?!
segments.speaker: BRIAN

segments.final_text: This won't do, Master Liam!
segments.speaker: BRIAN

segments.final_text:
The empire will not accept 
management by an AI!
segments.speaker: BRIAN

segments.final_text:
There is no such law. Utilizing AI as 
little as possible is simply preferred.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
As Master is still young and does not 
possess the knowledge for governance yet,
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
it would not be illegal to temporarily 
assign those duties to me.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: Brian, ready an education capsule.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
Amagi, I put you in charge of 
my territory while I'm in there.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: As you wish, Master.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: You can't, Master Liam!
segments.speaker: BRIAN

segments.final_text:
Letting an AI run your domain 
would be a massive scandal!
segments.speaker: BRIAN

segments.final_text: I am your lord. And my word is final.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: If you understand, get it ready.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Please wait, Master Liam! Anything but—
segments.speaker: BRIAN

segments.final_text: I'll see you later.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: I await your return.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: Oh, right, I forgot to ask you one thing.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: What is it?
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: Amagi, does your AI have emotions?
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Emotions?
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: I mean, even if you don't,
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text:
you may have an algorithm 
that mimics human behavior.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: I was just wondering how it works with you.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Well...
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
I cannot yet say if my AI 
has human emotions...
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
But when you said,
 "why don't we outcasts team up,"
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
those logs were so verbose that they 
caused a cache memory overflow.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: I thought I ordered the best possible specs?
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Strange, isn't it?
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text: Take care of things.
segments.speaker: LIAM

segments.final_text: Have a good sleep, Master.
segments.speaker: AMAGI

segments.final_text:
Allow me to show you to...
 "Way of the Flash."
